correctness.rationale: The open-neighborhood condition and closed-neighborhood code separation reduce to every cyclic five-column word satisfying a local test for n>=7; closed neighborhoods at cyclic column separation >=3 are disjoint, so total domination separates remaining pairs. Independent reconstruction of 256 four-column states found 661 admissible transitions and the unique cyclic strongly connected component of 147 states and 489 internal edges. Independently computed min-plus powers verify exact entrywise D_16=D_9+6 on all 21,609 entries and diagonal minima (6,8,9,9,10,11,12) at lengths 7..13. Associativity proves recurrence at all n>=9; direct lengths 14/15 handle 7/8. Independent exhaustive neighborhood subset enumeration yields minima/counts n=3..6: (4,9),(4,30),(5,32),(6,110). Consequently finite recurrence is a genuine all-length proof, not finite sampling.
residual_risks: Global five-column equivalence was justified combinatorially; direct all-word equality was not separately rerun for n=7 and n=8 in this audit, although independent small-optimum checks and exact min-plus identity were performed.
